title: Private account backup
description: Save study progress, decks, notes and preferences to your account. Backups are private; local XP does not count toward account rankings or rewards.
manual: Manual backup only. Changes stay on this device until you choose Save to account.
keep: Keep local and replace account backup
saveConfirm: Save the current account’s data to its private backup? This replaces the previously saved copy.
restoreConfirm: Replace this account’s device data with its saved backup? Unsaved changes will be lost.
importConfirm: Copy this browser’s demo data into the signed-in account’s device data? Current account data on this device will be replaced. Nothing uploads until you choose Save to account.
keepConfirm: Replace the latest account backup with your local data? Changes saved on another device will be overwritten.
saved: Saved to your private account backup. Later changes need another save.
restored: Account backup restored on this device.
imported: Browser data imported locally. Choose Save to account to upload it.
conflict: Another device changed the backup. Restore it, or explicitly keep your local data and replace the account backup.
requestFailed: Could not complete the request. No save or restore was confirmed. Check your connection and retry.
storageFailed: This device could not store your changes. Free browser storage before continuing.
accountChanged: The signed-in account changed. Review the account before trying again.
noBackup: This account has no saved backup yet.
